definitionZh: 将 lock 设置为 true，当拖动开始时拖动手势将 [requestPointerLock](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/requestPointerLock) 并在拖动手势结束时退出PointerLock。此功能仅适用于非触摸设备。
sourceDefinition: Set lock to true and the drag gesture will [requestPointerLock](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/requestPointerLock) when the drag starts and exitPointerLock when the drag gesture ends. This feature is only relevant on non-touch devices.
